title: Lord Nagafen (Seasonal)
summary: Seasonal Nagafen adds health-gated reinforcements and spell attacks to his chamber fight.
overview: Seasonal Nagafen adds health-gated reinforcements and spell attacks to his chamber fight.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Plan add pickup before crossing 70% and 40% and keep the current tank supported through spell thresholds.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Three random reinforcements appear at 70% health and again at 40%.
Additional targeted spells trigger at 60%, 30% and 10% health.
Keep the fight in his chamber; combat includes a boundary check and banishment handling.

notes: Approval E298. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
